scientific_question: Can a fully frozen, multilingual-noise-aware WavLM Base Plus backbone with a learnable weighted sum of all hidden layers provide a complementary representation to CAM++ without sacrificing known-speaker or OOD performance?

historical_raw_benchmark.system: English VoxCeleb-finetuned WavLM Base Plus SV x-vector, fixed 8-second center crop
historical_raw_benchmark.decision: Raw x-vector reuse is closed. It did not test the original SSL backbone, learnable hidden-layer aggregation, or a challenge-trained backend.

literature.title: Large-Scale Self-Supervised Speech Representation Learning for Automatic Speaker Verification
literature.relevance: Learnable averaging of every SSL hidden layer followed by an ASV backend substantially outperformed FBank.

literature.title: WavLM: Large-Scale Self-Supervised Pre-Training for Full Stack Speech Processing
literature.relevance: WavLM pretraining explicitly targets full-stack speech tasks and noise/overlap robustness.

literature.title: MMFA: Masked Multi-Layer Feature Aggregation for Speaker Verification Using WavLM
literature.relevance: Layer-dependent temporal attention and learnable layer weighting improve speaker verification under short/noisy conditions.

locked_change.single_scientific_change: Replace CAM++ features with original microsoft/wavlm-base-plus SSL features aggregated by a trainable softmax-weighted sum of all 13 hidden states and attentive statistical pooling.
locked_change.lme20_role: fixed diagnostic after the selected Raw checkpoint; no tuning

fold0_gate.passing_action: Permit a separate Fold1/Fold2 preregistration; do not create a submission from Fold0.
fold0_gate.failing_action: Close this P13 recipe and move to a different condition-robust frontend/backend hypothesis.

immediate_stop: OOM after one measured batch correction

operational_resolution_before_fold0_metr.optimizer_step_frequency_note: Batch size is an operational preregistration dimension resolved before any Fold0 metric. Epoch count still represents complete data passes; LR and all scientific dimensions remain unchanged.
